title: fix(console): save a language picked on the sign-in page as the person's own when they have none
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuWaHFkA9vyxuQvdUXUZnrDs)_
domain:ui#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVfPeFZkN1FP93imKU

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在登录页选了语言、本人还没设过语言偏好的，登录时这个选择会存成本人的语言偏好（`sys_user.locale`），换设备、发邮件都跟着走。
- 为什么改：#30338 只做到「选的语言在这台浏览器上留住」，没有存进个人偏好；登录页靠整页跳转离开，跳转前没人写库。
- 风险与回滚：只有登录页选过语言才多发两次请求（读一次本人记录、写一次），已有偏好不改，写失败照常登录。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`LoginPage.tsx` Post-login effect 新增的第 0 步；`useUserLocale.ts` 的 `saveSignInLanguagePick`。
- 两分钟验证：退出登录，在登录页底部的地球图标里选 Français，用一个没设过语言的账号登录，进个人资料页，语言应为 Français；刷新仍是法语。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30399

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `@object-ui/app-shell` `useUserLocale.ts`: a language picked while signed out is now also held for one save (`signInPickToSave`, page-load memory, no storage key). New `saveSignInLanguagePick(userId, writer?)` reads the person's `sys_user` row and, only when `locale` is unset, writes the pick through the column's one write door, `update('sys_user', id, { locale })`, the call `useLanguageSelection` makes. It spends the pick on the first call, sends no request when nothing was picked, and never rejects: a failed read or write logs once at `error` (the pick stays in the device slot, so this browser still renders it). `hasSignInLanguagePick()` answers whether there is anything to save.
- Barrel: `hasSignInLanguagePick`, `saveSignInLanguagePick` and the `SignInLanguagePickWriter` type are exported from `@object-ui/app-shell` (hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`; the claim's line says `no` and names this case for the seat to correct).
- `LoginPage.tsx`, the Post-login orchestration effect only: a new step 0 starts the save once (ref latch) when there is a pick, holds the spinner, and re-runs the effect when the save settles (state). Steps 1 to 3 are unchanged, so all five exits wait on it:

| Exit | Applies | Why |
|---|---|---|
| OAuth provider hand-off (`followOauthAuthorize`) | yes | a full navigation to the relying party; same person, same page-load |
| Mobile sign-in hand-off (`assign(handoff.target)`) | yes | full navigation; a session the hand-off refuses for its age is held to the form and saves nothing (it is not a sign-in yet) |
| No organization (`assign(root or redirect)`) | yes | full navigation |
| Several organizations (`assign('/organizations')`) | yes | full navigation |
| Final redirect (`assign(redirect or root)`, after the single-org auto-select) | yes | full navigation; the auto-select itself is not an exit |

The "Read public auth config" effect and the `DevAdminRow` render are untouched (#30420 is changing them in parallel).

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `f6faf751` and in a live sign-in (Verification below): the pick ends in the `objectui-locale` slot, `sys_user.locale` stays empty. Two findings the order's suggested route needed adjusting for:

- **No adapter on the sign-in page.** The order suggested awaiting `adapter.update('sys_user', id, { locale })`. `useAdapter()` answers `null` on `/login`: the console mounts `AdapterProvider` inside `ConnectedShell`, and the public auth routes render outside it. So `saveSignInLanguagePick` builds the same `ObjectStackAdapter` `AdapterProvider` builds (same base URL, `createAuthenticatedFetch`) for the one save. Live, that is one `GET /api/v1/discovery`, one `GET` and one `PATCH` on `/api/v1/data/sys_user/ID`, all before the next page-load's discovery.
- **The owner-change keeper spends its copy first.** #30338's `signedOutPick` is consumed by the owner-change event, which fires (inside `AuthProvider`) before the post-login effect runs, and never fires when the browser's last owner signs in again. So the save reads a second page-load copy, cleared by the same signed-in-switch path.

Route B as ruled: awaited before the navigation, no fire-and-forget, no new storage marker.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound, unchanged from #30338:** memory lasts one page-load. A pick followed by a reload of the sign-in page, or by an identity provider round-trip, is not saved.
- **No timeout on the save.** A request that hangs keeps the spinner up as long as the adapter's own fetch does; a refused or failed request lets the sign-in proceed. Noted, not added: a bound would be a choice of number nobody has ruled on.
- **Same shape, reported, not fixed (order):** `RegisterPage.tsx` renders the same footer language menu and leaves by the same four `window.location.assign` exits after a sign-up that signs the person in, so a pick made there is kept in the slot but not saved. `SetupPage.tsx` has no language menu of its own; a pick made on another signed-out page earlier in the same page-load would reach its two exits unsaved.
- **Observed, not this card's:** with no pick, the existing post-login effect can navigate twice in the test harness (once before the organizations answer, once after). The new pins assert only that the page leaves and saves nothing in that case.
- An existing language is kept even when the deployment does not offer it (live row 2: a stored `de` stays `de`); what renders then is the existing reader's business, unchanged here.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocaleSignInPick-30338.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (8 cases): saved for a new owner; saved when the last owner signs in again (no owner change); an existing language is read and kept; CONTROL no pick, no request; spent once; a signed-in switch replaces it; a failed write resolves, logs at `error`, slot kept; a failed read writes nothing.
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/signInLanguagePick-30399.test.tsx` (new, 11 cases): for each of the five exits, nothing leaves while the save is in flight and the expected exit is taken once it settles; CONTROL for each exit with no pick; a session the mobile hand-off refuses saves nothing.

## Verification

Live: showcase `pnpm dev -- --fresh` plus the console on vite, Playwright `en-US`, 1440 wide. Users created by the seeded admin. Row 1 before = this head with step 0 disabled in place (`ablation-replace --hold`, restored after).

| Row | Who | Picked | `sys_user.locale` after sign-in | Slot | Language after reload |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 before | no language of their own | Français | empty | fr | fr |
| 1 after | no language of their own (0 orgs, root exit) | Français | **fr** | fr | fr |
| 2 after | has `de` | Français | de (unchanged) | fr | fr |
| 3 after | no language of their own | nothing | empty, no PATCH sent | empty | en-US |
| 4 after | seeded admin (1 org, final exit) | Français | **fr** | fr | fr |

Requests in row 1 after, in order: `POST sign-in/email`, `GET discovery`, `GET sys_user/ID`, `PATCH sys_user/ID`, then the next page-load's `GET discovery`.
